items.title: 13.8.1 Aabi silver ion ke saath halides ke reactions (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 13.8.1 with Figure 13.2, printed pages 297-298.

blocks.text: Jab halide ions aqueous silver nitrate (AgNO₃) se react karte hain to insoluble (pani mein na ghulne wale) silver halides (AgX) bante hain. Yeh reactions qualitative analysis (kisi sample mein kaun se ions hain, yeh pehchanna) mein halide ions ko pehchanne ke liye istemal hote hain. Aam reaction yeh hai:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne aam equation X¹⁻(aq) + Ag¹⁻(aq) → 2AgX(s) chhapi hai. Is mein do ghaltiyan hain: silver ion positive hai, yani Ag¹⁺ (Ag¹⁻ nahi), aur ek Ag⁺ aur ek X⁻ mil kar sirf ek AgX banate hain (2AgX nahi). Sahi equation oopar di gayi hai.

Jab aqueous medium mein silver ions aur fluoride ions milaye jayen to koi reaction nazar nahi aata. Silver fluoride pani mein hal ho jata hai, is liye fluoride (F⁻) silver fluoride ka precipitate nahi banata.
Jab silver ions aur chloride ions milaye jayen to silver chloride ka safed (white) precipitate banta hai, jo dilute (halki) ammonia mein hal ho jata hai.
Aqueous silver ions ko aqueous bromide ions se milane par silver bromide ka cream rang ka precipitate banta hai. Yeh precipitate concentrated (gaarhi) ammonia mein thora sa (sparingly) hal hota hai.

blocks.alt: Teen test tubes saath saath, har ek do-tihai precipitate se bhari: baen safed silver chloride, beech mein cream rang ka silver bromide aur daen halka peela silver iodide.
blocks.caption: Figure 13.2: Silver halide precipitates ke rang: silver chloride (baen), silver bromide (beech) aur silver iodide (daen) (kitab ki Figure 13.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Rang se halide pehchana jata hai: safed (AgCl) matlab Cl⁻, cream (AgBr) matlab Br⁻, aur halka peela (AgI) matlab I⁻. Fluoride koi precipitate nahi deta kyun ke AgF pani mein hal ho jata hai. Kitab mein yeh tasveer (photo) hai; hum ne usi ka saada khaaka banaya hai.

Aqueous silver ions ko iodide solution se milane par silver iodide ka peela precipitate banta hai. Yeh product (AgI) ammonia mein hal nahi hota. (Kitab yahan “aqueous halide solution” likhti hai; murad iodide solution hai.)
Is qism ke reactions halide ions ko pehchanne ke liye istemal hote hain aur inhen silver nitrate test kehte hain.

blocks.caption: Silver nitrate test
rows: koi precipitate nahi (AgF ghul jata hai)

blocks.prompt: Aqueous fluoride silver nitrate ke saath precipitate kyun nahi deta, jab ke baqi halides dete hain?
blocks.explanation: Silver fluoride pani mein hal ho jata hai, jab ke AgCl, AgBr aur AgI pani mein bohat kam hal hote hain. Is liye Ag⁺ aur F⁻ solution hi mein rehte hain aur kuch nazar nahi aata.

items: Ag⁺ + X⁻ → AgX(s): F⁻ kuch nahi (AgF ghul jata hai); Cl⁻ safed; Br⁻ cream; I⁻ peela.
Yeh silver nitrate test qualitative analysis mein halides pehchanta hai.
Kitab ki aam equation mein Ag¹⁻ aur 2AgX ghalat chhape hain; sahi: X⁻ + Ag⁺ → AgX.
